title: Concept: Lockfile resolves a package over SSH
description: package-lock.json declares a lockfile entry that fetches over SSH from a git remote, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The install trusts whatever host key and account the build machine holds, so the bytes that run are decided outside the registry.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: The install trusts whatever host key and account the build machine holds, so the bytes that run are decided outside the registry.
